title: Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESI) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESI)
Jurisdiction: India (notified areas/establishments)
Category: Employment-linked social health insurance
Type: Public Healthcare Service
Details: Contributory social security scheme for covered employees, including medical care and specified cash benefits under the ESI Act and regulations.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Employees in covered establishments/notified areas who meet applicable wage ceiling and coverage conditions. Verify the current wage ceiling and establishment coverage.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: ESI insurance number/e-Pehchan details, identity and family/dependent details as requested by ESIC.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Coverage is generally initiated through the employer's ESIC registration. Access care through the assigned ESIC dispensary/hospital.
Official Portal: https://www.esic.gov.in/
